SELECT
    t.transportregistry,
    (
        (t.totaldeliverytons / dh.hubcaptons) *
        t.deliverysuccessrate *
        (1 - t.vehiclebreakrate / 100)
    ) * 100 AS lpm,
    CASE
        WHEN (
            (t.totaldeliverytons / dh.hubcaptons) *
            t.deliverysuccessrate *
            (1 - t.vehiclebreakrate / 100)
        ) * 100 < 100 THEN 'Logistics Breakdown'
        ELSE 'Normal Operation'
    END AS status
FROM
    transportation AS t
JOIN
    distributionhubs AS dh ON t.transporthubref = dh.hubregistry;

SELECT

    (t1.carbontons * (100 - t1.renewenergypct) * (100 - t1.recyclepct)) AS "Environmental Footprint Factor",
    CASE
        WHEN (t1.carbontons * (100 - t1.renewenergypct) * (100 - t1.recyclepct)) < 100 THEN 'Low'
        WHEN (t1.carbontons * (100 - t1.renewenergypct) * (100 - t1.recyclepct)) BETWEEN 100 AND 500 THEN 'Medium'

    END AS "Environmental Impact Classification"
FROM
    environmentandhealth AS t1
JOIN
    disasterevents AS t2 ON t1.envdistref = t2.distregistry
ORDER BY
    "Environmental Footprint Factor";

SELECT 
    t.transportregistry AS transport_registry_id,
    (
        (t.vehiclecount * 0.2) +
        (t.trucksavailable * 0.2) +
        (t.helosavailable * 0.15) +
        (t.boatsavailable * 0.15) +
        (t.totaldeliverytons * 0.1) +
        (t.dailydeliverytons * 0.1) +
        CASE 
            WHEN t.lastmilestatus = 'On Track' THEN 10
            WHEN t.lastmilestatus = 'Delayed' THEN 5
            ELSE 0
        END +
        (t.distributionpoints * 0.05) +
        (100 / (1 + t.avgdeliveryhours)) * 0.05 +
        (t.deliverysuccessrate * 0.05) +
        CASE 
            WHEN t.routeoptstatus = 'Optimized' THEN 5
            WHEN t.routeoptstatus = 'In Progress' THEN 3
            ELSE 0
        END +
        (t.fuelefficiencylpk * 0.03) +
        CASE 
            WHEN t.maintenancestate = 'Up to Date' THEN 5
            WHEN t.maintenancestate = 'Due' THEN 2
            ELSE 0
        END -
        (t.vehiclebreakrate * 0.02)
    ) AS lpm_score,
    CASE 
        WHEN (
            (t.vehiclecount * 0.2) +
            (t.trucksavailable * 0.2) +
            (t.helosavailable * 0.15) +
            (t.boatsavailable * 0.15) +
            (t.totaldeliverytons * 0.1) +
            (t.dailydeliverytons * 0.1) +
            CASE 
                WHEN t.lastmilestatus = 'On Track' THEN 10
                WHEN t.lastmilestatus = 'Delayed' THEN 5
                ELSE 0
            END +
            (t.distributionpoints * 0.05) +
            (100 / (1 + t.avgdeliveryhours)) * 0.05 +
            (t.deliverysuccessrate * 0.05) +
            CASE 
                WHEN t.routeoptstatus = 'Optimized' THEN 5
                WHEN t.routeoptstatus = 'In Progress' THEN 3
                ELSE 0
            END +
            (t.fuelefficiencylpk * 0.03) +
            CASE 
                WHEN t.maintenancestate = 'Up to Date' THEN 5
                WHEN t.maintenancestate = 'Due' THEN 2
                ELSE 0
            END -
            (t.vehiclebreakrate * 0.02)
        ) < 50 THEN 'Logistics Breakdown'
        ELSE 'Normal Operation'
    END AS status
FROM 
    transportation AS t;

5a4e7c2538e0b938b604c47f504d75541ceb0114.sql:
SELECT 
    de.distregistry AS registry_id,
    (
        (
            CASE 
                WHEN eh.medicalemergencycapacity = 'Adequate' THEN 1.0
                WHEN eh.medicalemergencycapacity = 'Limited' THEN 0.6
                WHEN eh.medicalemergencycapacity = 'Critical' THEN 0.3
                ELSE 0.0
            END
        ) * (
            CASE 
                WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 1' THEN 1
                WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 2' THEN 2
                WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 3' THEN 3
                WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 4' THEN 4
                WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 5' THEN 5
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) * (
            1 - (
                (
                    CASE 
                        WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 1' THEN 1
                        WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 2' THEN 2
                        WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 3' THEN 3
                        WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 4' THEN 4
                        WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 5' THEN 5
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ) / 6.0
            )
        )
    ) AS health_resilience_score,
    (
        CASE 
            WHEN 
                (
                    (
                        CASE 
                            WHEN eh.medicalemergencycapacity = 'Adequate' THEN 1.0
                            WHEN eh.medicalemergencycapacity = 'Limited' THEN 0.6
                            WHEN eh.medicalemergencycapacity = 'Critical' THEN 0.3
                            ELSE 0.0
                        END
                    ) * (
                        CASE 
                            WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 1' THEN 1
                            WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 2' THEN 2
                            WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 3' THEN 3
                            WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 4' THEN 4
                            WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 5' THEN 5
                            ELSE 0
                        END
                    ) * (
                        1 - (
                            (
                                CASE 
                                    WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 1' THEN 1
                                    WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 2' THEN 2
                                    WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 3' THEN 3
                                    WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 4' THEN 4
                                    WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 5' THEN 5
                                    ELSE 0
                                END
                            ) / 6.0
                        )
                    )
                ) < 0.5 THEN 'Health Crisis' 
            ELSE 'Normal Health Status'
        END 
    ) AS health_status
FROM 
    disasterevents de
JOIN 
    environmentandhealth eh ON de.distregistry = eh.envdistref
ORDER BY 
    de.distregistry;

WITH EnvironmentalImpactFactor AS (
    SELECT 
        t1.envhealthregistry AS environmental_registry,
        t2.affectedarea AS affected_area,
        t2.haztype AS hazard_type,
        (t1.carbontons * t1.renewenergypct * t1.recyclepct) AS environmental_footprint_factor,
        CASE 
            WHEN (t1.carbontons * t1.renewenergypct * t1.recyclepct) < 100 THEN 'Low'
            WHEN (t1.carbontons * t1.renewenergypct * t1.recyclepct) BETWEEN 100 AND 500 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'High'
        END AS environmental_impact_category
    FROM 
        environmentandhealth AS t1
    JOIN 
        disasterevents AS t2 ON t1.envdistref = t2.distregistry
)

ORDER BY environmental_registry;

        disasterevents de ON ba.benedistref = de.distregistry

    SELECT 
        financeregistry, 
        (donorcommitmentsusd / budgetallotusd) * (1 - fundsutilpct) * (1 - (resourcegapsusd / budgetallotusd)) AS fsr
    FROM 
        financials
),
status_cte AS (
    SELECT 
        financeregistry, 
        fsr, 
        CASE 
            WHEN fsr < 1 THEN 'Financial Crisis Risk' 
            ELSE 'Financially Stable' 
        END AS status
    FROM 
        fsr_cte
)
SELECT 
    financeregistry, 
    fsr AS financial_health_index, 
    status 
FROM 
    status_cte 
ORDER BY 
    fsr ASC;

WITH health_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        de.distregistry AS registry_id,
        (
            (
                CASE 
                    WHEN eah.medicalemergencycapacity = 'Adequate' THEN 1.0
                    WHEN eah.medicalemergencycapacity = 'Limited' THEN 0.6
                    WHEN eah.medicalemergencycapacity = 'Critical' THEN 0.3
                    ELSE 0.0
                END
            ) * (
                CASE 
                    WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 1' THEN 1
                    WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 2' THEN 2
                    WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 3' THEN 3
                    WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 4' THEN 4
                    WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 5' THEN 5
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) * (
                1 - (
                    CASE 
                        WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 1' THEN 1
                        WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 2' THEN 2
                        WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 3' THEN 3
                        WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 4' THEN 4
                        WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 5' THEN 5
                        ELSE 0
                    END / 6.0
                )
            )
        ) AS health_resilience_score
    FROM 
        disasterevents de
    JOIN 
        environmentandhealth eah ON de.distregistry = eah.envdistref
),
health_crisis AS (
    SELECT 
        hs.registry_id,
        hs.health_resilience_score,
        CASE 
            WHEN eah.diseaserisk = 'High' 
            AND eah.waterqualityindex < 50 
            AND hs.health_resilience_score < 40 THEN 'Health Crisis'
            ELSE 'Normal Health Status'
        END AS health_status
    FROM 
        health_scores hs
    JOIN 
        environmentandhealth eah ON hs.registry_id = eah.envdistref
)
SELECT 
    registry_id, health_resilience_score, health_status
FROM 
    health_crisis
ORDER BY 
    health_resilience_score;

WITH lpm_calc AS (
    SELECT
        t.transportregistry,
        (t.totaldeliverytons / dh.hubcaptons) * t.deliverysuccessrate * (1 - t.vehiclebreakrate / 100) * 100 AS lpm,
        CASE
            WHEN (t.totaldeliverytons / dh.hubcaptons) * t.deliverysuccessrate * (1 - t.vehiclebreakrate / 100) * 100 < 30
            AND t.lastmilestatus = 'Suspended'
            AND t.vehiclebreakrate > 15 THEN 'Logistics Breakdown'
            ELSE 'Normal Operation'
        END AS status
    FROM transportation t
    JOIN distributionhubs dh ON t.transporthubref = dh.hubregistry
)
SELECT transportregistry, lpm, status
FROM lpm_calc;

WITH lpm_cte AS (
    SELECT 
        t.transportregistry, 
        (
            (totaldeliverytons / d.hubcaptons) * deliverysuccessrate * (
                1 - (vehiclebreakrate / 100.0)
            ) * 100
        ) AS lpm
    FROM transportation AS t
    JOIN distributionhubs AS d ON t.transporthubref = d.hubregistry
),
logistics_breakdown_cte AS (
    SELECT 
        t.transportregistry, 
        CASE 
            WHEN lpm < 30 
                AND lastmilestatus = 'Suspended' 
                AND vehiclebreakrate > 15 THEN 'Logistics Breakdown' 
            ELSE 'Normal Operation'
        END AS status
    FROM lpm_cte AS l
    JOIN transportation AS t ON l.transportregistry = t.transportregistry
)
SELECT 
    l.transportregistry, 
    lpm, 
    status
FROM lpm_cte AS l
JOIN logistics_breakdown_cte AS lb ON l.transportregistry = lb.transportregistry;

WITH operation_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        opsregistry,
        CASE 
            WHEN opsstatus = 'Completed' AND (resourceallocstate = 'Critical' OR supplyflowstate = 'Disrupted') THEN 0
            WHEN opsstatus = 'Completed' AND (resourceallocstate = 'Limited' OR supplyflowstate = 'Strained') THEN 25
            WHEN opsstatus = 'Completed' AND supplyflowstate = 'Stable' THEN 50
            WHEN opsstatus = 'Scaling Down' AND (resourceallocstate = 'Critical' OR supplyflowstate = 'Disrupted') THEN 75
            ELSE 100
        END AS score
    FROM operations
)
SELECT 
    opsregistry,
    CASE 
        WHEN score >= 80 THEN 'Completed'
        WHEN score BETWEEN 50 AND 80 THEN 'Scaling Down'
        ELSE 'Active'
    END AS new_status
FROM operation_scores;
